newsitem.title: UK: LCE white sugar ends mostly weaker.
newsitem.headline: LCE white sugar ends mostly weaker.

text.p: London white sugar finished mostly weaker with buyers staying on the sidelines and activity centred on switches, traders said.
The front-month October contract closed down $1.70 at $349.00 per tonne, just 30 cents above its session low.
December ended $2.60 lower at its low of $343.40.
Turnover was 2,106 lots, dominated by Oct/Dec and Oct/March spread trading.
In Paris, October finished down $1.20 at $348.50 and December off 50 cents at $345.50.
